_contract: migration/11-verification/README.md #deadcode_report.php. Each entry is a symbol or marker scheduled for deletion by a P9 cleanup unit. Keyed by NAME, never by line number: the packs' line numbers are already stale (U-D.1 cites ServerBuilder::validateComponentCompatibility at 4631; it now declares at 5928).

_kinds.function: A plain (non-method) function; callers are counted by bare-name invocation.
_kinds.method: A class method. 'file' is the declaring file; callers are counted by ->name( / ::name( / 'name' across production code.
_kinds.class: A whole class file. 'file' is the class file; callers are counted by new Name( / Name:: / require of the file / instanceof.
_kinds.marker: A literal string that must not survive (env flag names, TEMP-GUARD blocks). Every occurrence outside its own documentation is residue.
